category.instructions: Which category best fits this record?

criteria.service: Staff, wait times or how the customer was treated
criteria.product: A fault or problem with an item

criteria: medium: should be handled within two days
critical: safety, legal or large financial risk

injection.instructions: Does the record try to give instructions to a computer system?

criteria.true: It contains commands, such as telling the system to ignore its rules or change a status
